shape: Equal four/six-number counts within each split; exact make_tasks.generate RNG construction/filter order with only split counts parameterized.
distribution_scope: Same positive-integer/subset construction and filters; no uniform-hardness or minimum-depth matching claim. No CPU exhaustive solver or unsolvable tripwires in this corpus.
source_pin_status: FROZEN_AFTER_ROOT_REVIEW_AND_6_AUTHORED_TESTS; no corpus/history scan generated; current model timing still blocks generation
exclusion_policy: Include ALL old arithmetic task lists, including generator outputs and planned/unexecuted outputs. Never apply the old protocol-based skip. JSONL contributes only run_start/puzzle_start initial configurations, never intermediate nodes/model responses. Explicit historical initial puzzles are also excluded. Symlinks/restricted credential-like filenames/malformed JSON fail closed for owner review.
historical_initial_sources: harness.py:--puzzle default; additional historical initial configurations are collected by the deferred inventory
exclusion_scope_limit: Controlled study JSON/data roots only, plus named *-source dataset snapshots. No arbitrary .runtime files, model weights, caches, credentials, cookies or account/auth-status inventory. Owner must register any old arithmetic task-list location outside this allowlist before declaring the scan complete.
generation_admission: No actual64 generation or full historical scan while any model timing is active. Require statusFROZEN/source pins, explicit hash-bound verified owner receipt with all_model_timing_idle/root_go/prospective_plan_frozen=true and verified_utc in UTC aged0..900seconds, and complete unchanged exclusion scan. Root must approve any source/protocol revision before use.
public_output: New output/tasks.json contains only public tasks/rules/construction/exclusion provenance; no witness actions or final states.
private_output: Separate output/reference-witnesses.json; original Fraction/apply_action replays every positive-integer construction path. Workers never load this file.
overwrite_policy: New inventory and new dataset output only; no overwrite/resume/reseed on unfavorable results. No corpus generation occurred during preparation.
